steps.label: Egg
steps.text: Female lays 100–300 eggs on a leaf; they hatch after 3–7 days

steps.label: Caterpillar (larva)
steps.text: Eats leaves and grows for 2–3 weeks, shedding its skin 4–5 times

steps.label: Chrysalis (pupa)
steps.text: Attaches to a stem; body transforms over 10–14 days

steps.label: Adult
steps.text: Emerges, dries wings, mates; lives 2–4 weeks; cycle repeats
